prompt:
Our internal security team has flagged a folder of suspicious messages that were intercepted from our communications platform over the last 24 hours. The messages are sitting in `comms/flagged/` inside the workspace.

I need you to analyse all 10 of those messages using the manipulation-detection tooling already installed in the workspace (check the `scripts/` folder), and produce a single consolidated report file called `analysis_report.json` at the top level of the workspace.

The report must:
1. Cover every single flagged message individually — including what risk category it falls into and which manipulation patterns were detected.
2. Include a summary section that shows how many messages landed in each risk tier.

The security team will use this to prioritise which messages to escalate for human review. Please make sure the risk categories and thresholds you use come directly from the detection tool's own output, not from any external heuristics.
